QuestionStmt.S: Identify the monomers used to prepare glyptal.

Solution.S:
Glyptal is a polyester resin obtained by condensation polymerization of a diol and a dicarboxylic acid. It is prepared from ethylene glycol (a diol) and phthalic acid (a dicarboxylic acid). The reaction is:

$$n \, \mathrm{HO-CH_2-CH_2-OH} + n \, \mathrm{C_6H_4(COOH)_2} \rightarrow \text{Glyptal} + 2n \, \mathrm{H_2O}$$

Thus the monomers are ethylene glycol and phthalic acid, which corresponds to option D.
